diagnosis.ngram_baseline_strong: 82.5% - char-ngram on goal text; the 30-pair corpus has near-duplicate phrasings per task, making lexical match strong
diagnosis.d8_v1_weakness: scored NLL of the FULL completion given a generic prompt; task discrimination diluted by shared boilerplate tokens. v2: score only discriminator tokens (object name), 1-shot structure, temperature on length-normalized NLL
diagnosis.verdict: v1 recorded as baseline-beats-router; NOT evidence against the d8 text-layer - the scoring rule was naive. v2 gate: d8 must beat 82.5% on same split or the layer stays ngram
